record.original_question: Develop a stochastic search algorithm for Costas arrays that continues to work at larger orders of practical interest, especially orders 30, 31, 32, and 33.

evidence.quote: Problem 13. Develop a stochastic search method for Costas arrays which works in large enough orders of interest (in particular, in orders 30, 31, 32, and 33).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Costas array of order $n$ is an $n\times n$ array with exactly one mark in each row and each column (equivalently, a permutation $f:\{1,\dots,n\}\to\{1,\dots,n\}$) such that all $\binom{n}{2}$ displacement vectors between distinct marks are distinct. Equivalently, for every triple of integers $(i,j,k)$ with $1\le i<i+k\le n$ and $1\le j<j+k\le n$ and $k\ne 0$, one has
$$f(i+k)-f(i)\ne f(j+k)-f(j) \quad\text{whenever } i\ne j.$$
The existence problem for Costas arrays at certain orders remains unresolved; in particular, no Costas array is known for orders $32$ and $33$, and only a handful are known for orders $30$ and $31$, while complete enumerations have only been carried out up through order $29$.

Design a stochastic (randomized) search algorithm for Costas arrays which is effective at orders $n=30,31,32,33$. Specifically, exhibit such an algorithm together with evidence that it can locate Costas arrays of these orders (or, in the case of $n=32,33$, decisively succeed in producing one if any exist), within practical computational resources.
artifact.status_search_result: No stochastic search method to date has been shown to reliably find Costas arrays at orders 32 and 33; existence at these orders is unknown, and only a few examples are known at orders 30 and 31. Bayesian analyses suggest the rarity of Costas permutations makes naive stochastic search ineffective at these orders. Large-scale parallel constraint-based local search has been studied but has not produced new arrays at these problematic orders.

status_evidence.snippet: All Costas arrays have been enumerated up to order 29. Orders 32 and 33 are the smallest for which no Costas array is known.
status_evidence.claim: Existence at orders 32 and 33 remains unknown.

status_evidence.claim: Stochastic/local-search methods have been developed but have not resolved orders 32, 33.
